structured.answer: If I put in 750 ₪ a month for 15 years and nothing at the start, the page shows about 179,889 ₪, on 135,000 ₪ I put in. It says this is "בכסף של היום", meaning it already takes off 2% a year for inflation, and it guesses the fund grows 7% a year. It says to keep the money in an account at "פסגות ניירות ערך" and buy the fund "ילין לפידות מחקה S&P 500 (4D)". These aren't my bank, so before I give anyone money I'll ask you or the bank.

stuck.why: I typed 750 in the box, but the slider under it says 800. For a moment I didn't know which number it uses. The 135,000 ₪ (750 × 180) told me it used 750
Nothing on the main screen gives the inflation number. I had to press the 'אינפלציה' button, and only in the small window did I see 2%
